capabilities: Imports dropped emails as .eml files beside the target note
Adds a paperclip heading, link and collapsed preview
Embeds images and links documents from attachments
Extracts email attachments beside the EML
Applies date prefixes and kebab-case file naming
extras: Early release; mobile unsupported; native email dragging needs a separately installed, ad-hoc-signed macOS receiver; all parsing runs locally with no network requests, accounts or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn emails dragged from Apple Mail or Outlook into preserved .eml files with their attachments and consistent links in the note.

relations.evidence: Choose Use attachment rules under Attachment drops with the Attachment Link Rules 0.2.0 or later enabled.
Drag emails from Apple Mail or Microsoft Outlook into an Obsidian note.
Drag emails from Apple Mail or Microsoft Outlook into an Obsidian note.

summary: Drag-and-drop importer that saves Apple Mail and Outlook emails as .eml files beside a note, with links, collapsed previews and attachment handling.
